description: This file defines the ApiService class in an Angular frontend application, providing methods for authentication, game management, and move handling via HTTP requests to a backend API.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods for user authentication, game creation/joining, and move management by making HTTP requests to a backend API.

methods.name: authHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with optional authorization token from local storage.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Sends a registration request with username and password.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends a login request with username and password, returning authentication info.

methods.name: createGame
methods.description: Creates a new game, optionally assigning 'X' or 'O'.

methods.name: joinGame
methods.description: Joins an existing game by its ID.

methods.name: myGames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of games owned or participated in by the current user.

methods.name: getGame
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific game by ID.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Makes a move in a specified game at a given row and column.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the game by ID.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches the move history for a specific game.
